name: Lyo.Media.Models
tagline: Sibling IAudio* and IVideo* contracts, encoder catalogs, and conversion/play/probe records. Images stay IImageService.
description: Contracts for audio and video convert, probe, and play. There is no IMediaConverter: audio and video do not share a convert matrix, and images stay [`IImageService`](../../Images/Lyo.Images/README.md). Containers live on [`MediaContainer`](../../../Core/Common/Lyo.Common.Core/README.md) in Common.Core. Encoders (`AudioEncoder`, `VideoEncoder`, `PixelFormat`, `EncoderPreset`) live here. Take this package from libraries that only need the abstractions (mocking, custom backends, host bindings). Register the FFmpeg implementation in [`Lyo.FFmpeg`](../Lyo.FFmpeg/README.md).
features: **Two families.** IAudioConverter / IAudioProber / IAudioPlayer and IVideoConverter / IVideoProber / IVideoPlayer. No shared converter base.
**Shared plumbing that is not a converter.** IMediaProcessSession (live stdout), MediaIoMode, MediaProgress, MediaProbeResult (muxed files list every stream; attached_pic is not HasVideo).

**Factories.** ForRawPcm, ForCompressAudio, and ForExtract on audio. ForCompressVideo, ForStreamingVideo, ForGif, ForHls, ForDash, and ForThumbnail on video. ForStreamingVideo defaults to fragmented Mp4; WebM is copy plus pipe with no movflags.

**Builders.** AudioConversion and VideoConversion return a builder. Build() is the file request. BuildOptions() is the knobs for streams and StartConvertAsync. BuildConcat() is the multi-file request.
**PcmFrameReader.** Slices s16le PCM into 20 ms frames without referencing Discord. Single-consumer.
**Thread-safe catalogs.** TryFromName / Custom use ConcurrentDictionary. Bitrate, sample rate, channels, CRF, and frame rate are records (`MediaBitRate` id `128k`, not a raw string).
**Tags.** Convert metadata dictionaries use [`FileTagKey`](../../FileTags/Lyo.FileTags/README.md). The same catalog is what file storage stores under `fileTags`.

sections.title: Public types
rows: IAudioConverter
Audio convert matrix, StartConvertAsync, StartRawPcmAsync, ExtractAsync, ConcatAsync. Always drops video. Null ExtractAsync options use ForExtract (AAC in M4A).
IVideoConverter
Video convert matrix, StartConvertAsync, ExtractFrameAsync, ConcatAsync. Concat uses the demuxer and still needs a matching stream layout.
IAudioProber / IVideoProber
ProbeAsync / ProbeStreamAsync / ProbeBytesAsync return MediaProbeResult. Each flattens the first real audio vs first real video stream.
IAudioPlayer / IVideoPlayer
Local play. NoDisplay defaults true; video window is opt-in. Network streaming is StartConvertAsync.
IMediaProcessSession
Running convert: StandardOutput readable before exit. Single-consumer. Dispose cancels. No process timeout.
AudioConversionOptions / VideoConversionOptions
Records with Validate(). Factories on the matching type. AudioConversion and VideoConversion build them. Progress callbacks fire on the process I/O thread.
AudioEncoder / VideoEncoder / PixelFormat / EncoderPreset
Static instances, TryFromName / TryFromId, Custom. Ids are codec tokens (h264, hevc, av1, mp3, flac), not backend encoder names. EncoderPreset.Svt8 is the libsvtav1 default. P1 through P7 are NVENC.
PcmFrameReader
IAsyncEnumerable of s16le frames. Default 20 ms, 48 kHz, stereo.
MediaBitRate / AudioSampleRate / ChannelLayout / ConstantRateFactor / VideoFrameRate
Named values for bitrate, hertz, channel count, CRF, and frame rate. Custom and FromHertz / FromCount / FromValue / FromDouble cover the rest.
HardwareAccel / ScaleMode / SubtitleMode / LoudnessTarget / StreamPackaging
GPU device, scale behavior, subtitle burn-in or copy, loudnorm targets, and HLS/DASH segment settings.
